The '''Yminis sector''' was a [[sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It was located across grid squares S-14 and S-15 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" />

The sector contained the [[Alvorine system]], [[Barnahof system]], [[Borga system]], [[Croce system]], [[Dene Gois Cluster]], [[Derso system]], [[Drash-So system]], [[Hrill system]], [[Kemix system]], [[Kolanda Station system]], [[Morgania system]], [[Nimgorrhea system]], [[Noomis Riga system]], [[Rocun Cluster]], [[Rotas system]], [[RTK111 system]], [[Threndria system]], [[Xilxash system]], and [[Zznza system]].<ref name="Appendix" />
